name: Mutate — a card under the top takes the top card's colors, and the stack's counters are on the merged permanent
notes: Gemrazer is mutated over Serra Angel, which has a +1/+1 counter. The merged permanent has Gemrazer's colors and mana cost (CR 702.140e), and every counter on any of its cards. _applyMutateLayer1 copied name, types, P/T and abilities from the top card but not colors or mana cost, so the buried Angel's state stayed white and Crusade gave it +1/+1; its counter was not on the top card's state (counts read only the top card since mutate-stack-counts-as-one-creature).
